refinement_objective: CVaR at alpha 0.2 of original penalized cost, normalized by the fixed QUBO scale; feasibility and within-5-percent-optimum success reported separately
selection_rule: For each endpoint retain shallowest candidate with converged-target fidelity at least .98, otherwise highest fidelity and explicitly mark threshold unmet. Hardware screening chooses the endpoint by lowest prefixed-QAOA CVaR. Three equal-budget SPSA updates refine QAOA angles for selected prefix and standard p=1. Final two randomized blocks evaluate untouched screening parameters and final updated parameters, plus standard p=2, shallow-prefix, and matched uncompressed-prefix controls. No final outcomes used for tuning.
scope: Bounded exploratory hardware pilot, one independent instance at each model/size, no population or quantum-advantage claim. AQC-Tensor uses normalized MPS targets and physical-edge shallow ansatzes. QAOA retains full problem interactions and can require routing. No repair or postselection. Final measurement evaluation separated from screening and tuning.
routing_amendment: Preserve all v1 numerical choices; recompile with gatewise-verified seeded SABRE before acquisition. Original queued screen cancelled without execution or QPU usage.
